rules.baselineImmutability: The frozen baseline may not be silently overwritten or mutated without formal change authorization.
rules.changeIdRequirement: Every future modification to planning artifacts requires a registered change ID and rationale.
rules.impactAnalysisRequirement: All affected requirements, capabilities, tasks, tests, and release gates must be explicitly identified prior to change approval.
rules.hashTraceability: Modified files require pre-change and post-change cryptographic SHA-256 hashes.
rules.dependencyValidation: Dependency graph changes require structural cycle check and reachability matrix revalidation.
rules.adrDecisionReview: Architecture Decision Record changes require formal technical decision review and sign-off.
rules.architecturalChangeReview: Major architectural changes require a new independent review cycle.
rules.amendmentHistoryPreservation: Implementation discoveries may create formal append-only amendments but must never rewrite historical baseline records.
rules.frozenManifestPreservation: Previous frozen manifests remain permanently preserved in immutable execution control history.
rules.freezeVersionIncrement: A new planning freeze version is required after any approved planning amendment cycle.

changeHistory.contradiction: The final-freeze validator correctly forbids all Codebase drift but was incorrectly being used as the post-start implementation success gate.
changeHistory.resolution: Preserve FINAL_FREEZE_CERTIFICATION unchanged and add a separate fail-closed IMPLEMENTATION_EXECUTION_CERTIFICATION with receipt-chain, checkpoint, dependency, path-scope, and failed-WIP exclusion validation.
